title: 一週步數統計
question:
請輸入七天的步數（星期一到星期日）存進清單，用迴圈算出一週總共走了幾步，再找出走最多的是星期幾（1 到 7）。
先輸出總步數，再輸出星期幾；如果有兩天一樣多，輸出比較前面的那一天。

test_case.note: 星期一和星期三一樣多，輸出比較前面的 1

en.title: Weekly Steps
en.question:
Input the steps for 7 days (Monday to Sunday) into a list. Use a loop to find the total steps, and the day with the most steps (1 to 7).
Output the total first, then the day. If two days are the same, output the earlier day.

test_case.note: Monday and Wednesday are the same: output 1
